question: Why do sun moon and fire not illumine that abode?
premises: sun moon and fire do not illumine it
those who go there do not return
it is supreme and beyond instrument limitation
inference: The supreme abode transcends ordinary luminaries and instruments.
uncertainties: long fused compounds may hide editorial glosses
plain_english: Neither sun nor moon nor fire illumines it; having gone there one does not return; that supreme abode of mine is beyond the limitation of space, time, and instruments.
